body:
Strong, carefully-hedged audit — all 191 GOA rows accounted for (per-gene counts match goa.tsv exactly), all REMOVEs are bare GO:0005515 under the sanctioned policy, and the MesD/MesB/MesX handling (GO:0008172 rather than GO:0003871/GO:0008705 because the donor is unidentified) is exemplary. Requesting changes for four localized evidence-attachment defects, not biology errors:

1. ECOLI/metK: both GO:0000287 magnesium rows (L16-52) cite PMID:10551856's tripolyphosphate quote, which contains no metal content; the correct PMID:6251075 quote is already in the same file's references block. GO:0005524 ATP binding (L252) cites a cysteine-mutant activity result and its reason is copy-pasted from the metal rows.

2. ECOLI/metH: GO:0031419 cobalamin binding (L343), GO:0008705 (L232) and GO:0071265 (L511) are supported by PMID:8572314's cobalamin-INdependent sentence; the same abstract contains the cobalamin-dependent one.

3. ECOLI/metH: the 'folate glutamyl-chain length / exact MetE substrate distinction' clause is pasted onto three rows it does not justify.

4. THEMA/mtaD: all five MODIFY rows propose GO:0004000 and GO:0090613 as co-equal replacements, but your own 23968233-scope.md records them 300-1200x below SAH efficiency and core_functions keeps only SAH and MTA. State the promiscuous-activity tier per projects/ENZYME_SPECIFICITY.md.

Plus four non-blocking suggestions (stripped PMID prefixes running into adjacent words in ~31 places, the mmuM GO:0033528 UNDECIDED rationale, a self-identical supporting_text in PSEPK/metH, and the metK homodimer/tetramer note).

Full detail: https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/pull/6196#issuecomment-6706163015
